minutes.headline: Board found both greyhounds dangerous, delayed the penalty to Oct 15, and approved eight Unitil tree removals.
minutes.summary: The board heard a presentation on buying the Saliba land, held a shade-tree hearing on Unitil's tree work, and held a long dangerous-dog hearing after a greyhound attack. It chose three citizen members for the TC Passios design committee, ratified a staff appointment and made recommendations on special town meeting articles. The dog penalty was left for next week.

budget_items.what_was_said: Negotiated price for the whole parcel was set, against an assessed value and an appraisal.
Two state grants were awarded at their maximums, reimbursing most of the cost, which leaves a net town cost.
The town must authorize the full amount and carry it until reimbursed, then borrow the remainder. Annual debt service was estimated for a five-year and a 20-year bond.
The dog owners' insurance is covering vet and medical bills.
The finance director estimated free cash and reported ClearGov transparency software is live.
The accounts payable warrant total was read.
Article E would transfer a stated sum into the reserve capacity stabilization fund.

what_happened.line: The board found the dog dangerous, 4-0 with one abstention, and continued the hearing to October 15 at 7:30 for the penalty.
Testimony in the dog hearing is closed; the final penalty determination comes on October 15.
The board approved removal of the eight public trees Unitil recommended, and approved removing brush three inches or less, 4-1.
The board appointed citizen members to the TC Passios building design committee and ratified the principal clerk appointment.
The board recommended the Saliba property acquisition article, 4-0 with one abstention, and deferred its recommendation on the Butterfly Lane article.

why_it_matters: The Saliba purchase would be authorized in full and carried until state grants reimburse it, with the remainder borrowed, so it may affect future debt payments paid mostly from taxes.
The dog penalty is still undecided, and the tree and brush decisions touch roadside trees and scenic roads, with five trees the planning board did not approve still unsettled.
watch_next: October 15 at 7:30: the board's final penalty determination in the dangerous dog hearing.
The special town meeting vote on the warrant articles, including Saliba, and the board's deferred recommendation on the Butterfly Lane article.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. reconciliation.summary: The records agree on most recommendation votes and key figures, though captions garbled several names and the amounts. The main difference is that our recording left several votes inaudible, while the official minutes record failed nominations (Christen 3-3, Walker 2-4) and the failed scenic-roads brush motion (1-4). Also check the Article E sewer transfer, the Lorden ratification and the eight-trees vote, which only we record.
